**Initial message with non-cleartext IEs**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / 5GMM common procedures / Security mode control procedure |
| Tags | negative, security |
| Verdict class | WARN |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 20s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 4.4.6 a) (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 has no clause 4.4.6 and protects the initial NAS message with a hash instead; the cleartext IEs and the NAS message container are in V15.7.0 and unchanged in substance through V19.8.0)
- TS 24.501 5.4.2.4 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 names the IE "Replayed NAS message container"; "NAS message container" by V15.7.0)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-INITIAL-MSG-NONCLEARTEXT-ACCEPTED.md).
